name: Civilizations
author: Agriche
description: Kingdoms evolve from the Paleolithic to the Information Age over 15,000–20,000 years: featuring hundreds of technologies across various development paths (real-world, steam, Tesla-inspired, diesel, atomic, and biological), customizable governments and ideologies, elections, xenophobia/xenophilia, corporations, currencies, energy systems, trains, airplanes, rockets, a spherical world, and an internet for NPCs.
